haul their quads and room to take the whole gang along for the fun.
For those who desire the ultimate expression of muscle—built to both perform and stand apart—Durango
SRT Hellcat® Jailbreak delivers. With available seating for up to seven passengers, it unleashes new color
combinations, interior finishes and design options that let drivers create their own version of defiance.

P E R F O R M A N C E I N S P I R E D
The Durango interior is everything it should be—designed to be driver-centric, tech-friendly and spacious
enough for up to seven passengers plus cargo. The available, Fold-and-Tumble, second-row Captain’s
Chairs include soft-touch armrests and a floor-mounted mini console (with full center console with
storage on Jailbreak models). The standard Uconnect® 5 system helps keep you informed and entertained.
The large, full-color, 10.1-inch touchscreen integrates with your smartphone allowing you to upload,
download, post and search - all while on the go. The 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hotspot1* is included on models
equipped with Uconnect 5 and boasts fast processing speeds that help keep up to eight devices connected.
Durango SRT Hellcat® Jailbreak interior shown with Hammerhead Laguna leather seats.
*All disclosures can be found on the last page.
